name: Yotta D1 (Greater Noida Data Center Park)
notes: Yotta D1, first of six planned buildings in the ~20-acre Greater Noida Data Center Park (Tusiana, GB Nagar), inaugurated by CM Yogi Adityanath on 2 Nov 2022 as North India's first hyperscale data center; ~5,000 racks, 30 MW IT load (expandable to 50 MW), park cited at 160 MW / up to 250-350 MW across six buildings (30,000 racks).

name: Yotta D2 & D3 (Greater Noida Data Center Park)
notes: Construction of Yotta D2 and D3 (30 MW IT load each) in the Greater Noida park announced to start January 2022 with go-live targeted January 2024; trade coverage describes D2 as a 60 MW AI facility planned to host 30,000 NVIDIA Blackwell B300 Ultra GPUs, part of a campus scalable to 250 MW.

name: Yotta D4-D6 (Greater Noida Data Center Park expansion)
notes: The Greater Noida park is planned for six data center buildings with ~30,000 racks; buildings D4-D6 remain in planning under a Rs 39,000 crore (~$4.7bn) multi-year investment program with total park capacity cited at 160 MW.

name: AdaniConneX Noida Data Center (Sector 62/80, Noida)
notes: Adani Enterprises was allotted ~34,275 sq m in Noida (C Block, Phase 2, Sector 62) and Noida authority subleased a ~10-acre Sector 80 plot to the Adani data centre; AdaniConneX's Noida facility under construction with ~100 MW IT load and TIA-942-B Rated 3 DCCC certification per operator. A power-distribution licence application for the Sector 62 data centre park (DCDNL, Plot 20) was moved before UPERC.

name: Sify Noida 02 hyperscale campus (Greater Noida)
notes: Sify's Noida 02 AI-ready hyperscale campus (Sector 132, Greater Noida) designed for three towers with ~13,000+ racks and 78 MW IT capacity (some sources cite 130 MW power); CM Yogi inaugurated the first data center building in March 2025.

name: Sify Noida 01
